content: Pregnant individuals diagnosed with either type 1 or type 2 diabetes should be advised to take a low-dose aspirin regimen, specifically 100 to 150 milligrams per day, beginning between 12 and 16 weeks of gestation. This intervention is recommended to reduce the risk of developing preeclampsia. If a dosage of 162 milligrams per day is deemed appropriate and available, it may also be used. Alternatively, if 162-milligram tablets are not accessible, an 81-milligram tablet can be considered as a viable option.
